title: Housing Permits
scope: Covers Census Building Permits Survey: year-to-date authorized units by state. Also reports the FHFA all-transactions house-price index annual change by state and the S&P/CoreLogic Case-Shiller Boston and Miami MSA indexes (FRED BOXRSA and MIXRSA). Boston is the only Massachusetts city in that series; Miami is the Florida 20-city counterpart.
exclusions: Does not cover Florida insurance (that is DL-02), individual listings, or advice about buying a house.
heritage: Formerly Housing Production and Housing Prices
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from Census BPS state year-to-date files st2606y.txt and the matching 2025 file. Units are 1-unit + 2-unit + 3-4 unit + 5-or-more, reported buildings' units columns. The U.S. total is the sum of published state rows, not a separate Census U.S. line. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Building permits by state, the production side of the housing file.
lead: Permit-issuing places authorized 721,052 housing units in the United States through Jun 2026, -1.3% from the same months of 2025 (derived, SRC-616-01). Massachusetts authorized 7,148, rank 30 of 51 (derived, SRC-616-01). The FHFA all-transactions house-price index rose 3.65% in Massachusetts in 2025, rank 21 of 51 on annual change (derived, SRC-616-02). Florida changed -0.53%, rank 51 of 51 (derived, SRC-616-02). New Jersey had the largest increase at 6.16% (SRC-616-02). The S&P/CoreLogic Case-Shiller Boston index was 356.29 in 2026-05 (+2.7% from a year earlier) (SRC-616-03). Boston is the only Massachusetts city in that series. The Miami MSA index was 448.14 in 2026-05 (+1.8% from a year earlier) (SRC-616-03).
